**[[Aka'liit]]<ref name="Akaliit">Per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] held the title during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[738 BBY]] and [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]]. ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' establishes that the Mandalores during the time between the [[Mandalorian Excision]] and [[Jaster Mereel]] becoming Mandalore&mdash;events that ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to those two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], respectively&mdash;belonged to the [[Aka'liit]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].</ref>

{{Quote|Having defeated the Ithullans in a war over a narcolethe distillery in 200 B.B.Y., the Mandalorians then went on to exterminate the entire Ithullan species. Unfortunately, the Jedi Council did nothing in response to the genocide, and several rogue Jedi allied with the Bounty Hunters' Guild to take down the ruling Mandalore.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC" />}}
An '''individual''' served as the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], the leader of<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Aka'liit]] faction of<ref name="Akaliit" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, in the aftermath of the [[Mandalorian–Ithullan war|war]] of [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]] that saw the Mandalorians [[Speciecide|exterminate]] the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ithullan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. After the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] did not act in response to the genocide, a group of rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] made an alliance with the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] with the goal of taking down the reigning Mandalore of that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="NEC" />

Eventually, the Mandalorians' actions in the war against the Ithullans led to a schism among the Aka'liit that resulted in the rise of the [[True Mandalorians|True Mandalorian]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] splinter factions<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> and, in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jaster Mereel]] becoming Mandalore representing the True Mandalorians.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The alliance against the Mandalore in the wake of the Ithullans' extinction was later noted in the [[36 ABY]] [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|chronicle]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalore was mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="NEC" />
